rule: Every tool family is judged once: WORKFLOW (staged orchestration with a declared evidence root and resume path, satisfying docs/console/CONSOLE_WORKFLOW_ARCHITECTURE.md WorkflowSpec), STEP (invoked by a WORKFLOW, no standalone side effects), STANDALONE (single-purpose tool), or LIBRARY (imported, no entrypoint). New scripts must be judged before use, and new scripts are expected to be workflow form unless the row says why not; a *_workflow.py entrypoint that is not triaged WORKFLOW fails the gate. Existing scripts migrate in reviewed batches: a row that is not yet workflow form carries target_form + milestone and shows up as a migration warning until it is converted. Non-UNASSESSED families without a row fail; UNASSESSED legacy families warn until qualified.
